profile.headline: Software Developer, Systems Admin
profile.summary: I have an insatiable passion for code and generally everything tech.  I thoroughly enjoy both the front and back-end of web development.  I enjoy creating everything from web apps, to APIs, to visualizations, to  indie games.

positions.title: Software Development Intern
positions.description:
In my time at Pancake, I had many valuable experiences.  It was very enjoyable to work with a small software development team and see its dynamics.  I had fun learning new technologies as well as how to be a better communicator and fulfill my role in the team.
A few of the tools we used:
• Alfred Workflows
• Ruby
• Angular
• Various APIs
• Firebase
• HTML, CSS, JS, jQuery
